question_text: How many cumulative laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease cases (DRC and Uganda combined) will there be since the outbreak declaration on 14 May 2026 to 31 October 2026, according to WHO?
resolution_criteria: The latest confirmed-case total in the WHO report covering on or nearest before October 31 2026. Source: WHO Ebola (DRC 2026) situation reports and Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: How many cumulative reported deaths (confirmed plus probable) will there be in the Bundibugyo outbreak since the outbreak declaration on 14 May 2026 to 31 December 2026, according to WHO?
resolution_criteria: The death total in the WHO report covering on or nearest before 31 December 2026. Source: WHO situation reports.

question_text: Will the Bundibugyo virus disease PHEIC still be in effect on 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE if the PHEIC has not been terminated by 31 December 2026. Source: WHO IHR Emergency Committee statements and the Director-General PHEIC determinations.

question_text: How many countries other than DRC or Uganda will report at least one laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo case linked to this outbreak by 31 December 2026? (Baseline is 1 – France)
resolution_criteria: The number of countries other than DRC or Uganda with at least one laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo case linked to this outbreak, as of 31 December 2026. Baseline 1 (France). Source: WHO Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: Which is the furthest Bundibugyo countermeasure milestone reached by 31 December 2026? (Baseline: Oxford Phase I Bundibugyo vaccine trial launched 13 July 2026. WHO therapeutic trial, remdesivir and MBP134, began enrolling patients on 2 July 2026)
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the furthest milestone reached, per WHO, the trial sponsors, or the regulator, as of 31 December 2026. Source: WHO, ICTRP and other trial registries, partner announcements.

question_text: How many human H5 infections (any neuraminidase subtype) will be reported to WHO globally between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: Count of newly reported human H5 cases with onset or report date inside the window, as of 31 December 2026. Source: WHO Influenza at the human-animal interface assessments and Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: Will WHO or a national public health authority confirm at least one cluster meeting its stated criteria for sustained human-to-human transmission of an H5 virus on or before 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE on a WHO or national-authority statement reporting confirmed onward human-to-human spread beyond a single generation by 31 December 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: What will be the predominant H5 subtype among human cases reported globally from 1 July 2026 to 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: The subtype with the most reported human cases in the window, as of 31 December 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: How many US states will have H5N1 dairy-cattle detections by 31 December 2026? Number is cumulative states reporting H5N1 in livestock since outbreak was declared in 2024.
resolution_criteria: Cumulative count of US states with H5N1 dairy-cattle detections as of 31 December 2026. Source: USDA APHIS livestock detections.

question_text: How many new PHEICs will be declared for events not already under a PHEIC as of 1 July 2026, during 1 July 2026 to 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: Count of new PHEIC determinations by the Director-General in the window, as of 31 December 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: How many chikungunya cases will be in the Americas from 1 January to 31 December 2026, according to PAHO?
resolution_criteria: Chikungunya cases reported in the Americas in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Baseline 164,889 suspected as of July 9 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: Will WHO declare a new PHEIC for mpox at any point between 15 July 2026 and 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE on a fresh mpox PHEIC determination in the window, by 31 December 2026. The prior mpox PHEIC was lifted September 5 2025. Source: WHO.

question_text: How many cumulative human mpox cases will be reported to WHO globally between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: New confirmed cases reported in the window, as of 31 December 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: WHO multi-country mpox external situation reports.

question_text: How many US confirmed measles cases will be reported from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: US confirmed measles cases in 2026 per the CDC measles tracker, as of 31 December 2026. Source: CDC.

question_text: Will PAHO or WHO determine that the United States has lost measles elimination status on or before 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE if PAHO or WHO declares the US has lost measles elimination status on or before 31 December 2026. Source: PAHO.

question_text: How many measles-associated deaths will be reported in the U.S. from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: US measles-associated deaths in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Source: CDC.

question_text: How many global cholera cases will be reported globally from 1 January to 31 December 2026, according to WHO?
resolution_criteria: Global cholera cases reported in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: WHO multi-country cholera epidemiological update.

question_text: How many dengue suspected cases will be reported in the Americas from 1 January to 31 December 2026, according to PAHO?
resolution_criteria: Dengue suspected cases in the Americas in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: PAHO dengue situation reports.

question_text: How many EU/EEA countries will report locally acquired autochthonous chikungunya in 2026, as of 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: EU/EEA countries reporting locally acquired chikungunya in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Source: ECDC.

question_text: How many Americas countries or territories will report confirmed Oropouche in 2026, as of 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: Americas countries or territories reporting confirmed Oropouche in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Source: PAHO.

question_text: Will WHO declare a new filovirus outbreak distinct from the ongoing Bundibugyo event between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE if WHO declares a new Marburg or Ebola-species outbreak not linked to the current Bundibugyo event, by 31 December 2026. Source: WHO Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: How many wild poliovirus type 1 cases will be reported globally in 2026, as of 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: Wild poliovirus type 1 cases reported globally in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: GPEI polioeradication.org.

question_text: Will WHO designate a new SARS-CoV-2 variant of interest or variant of concern in the second half of 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE on any new VOI or VOC designation between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026. Source: WHO variant tracking.

question_text: How many measles cases will be reported to WHO globally in 2026, as of 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: Global measles cases reported to WHO in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: How many cholera-related deaths will be reported globally from 1 January to 31 December 2026, according to WHO?
resolution_criteria: Cholera-related deaths reported globally in 2026, as of 31 December 2026. Source: WHO cumulative 2026 cholera and AWD death total.
